raw.title: Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)
raw.extract: Wuxing (Chinese: 五行; pinyin: wǔxíng; Jyutping: Ng5 Hang4), translated as Five Moving Ones, Five Circulations, Five Types of Energy, Five Elements, Five Transformations, Five Phases or Five Agents, is a fivefold conceptual scheme used in many traditional Chinese fields of study to explain a wide array of phenomena, including terrestrial and celestial relationships, influences and cycles that characterise the interactions and relationships within science, Traditional Chinese medicine, Confucianism, Taoism, social relationships and education within Chinese culture.
